requirement.statement: The project SHALL provide an interpreter runtime that uses the versioned depa-actor@0.2.0 package contract as its generic execution substrate without a machine-specific or repository-local file dependency.

case.given: depa-actor@0.2.0 is configured as a registry dependency
case.when: The interpreter runtime is built
case.then: The runtime SHALL import depa-actor primitives for instruction stack, operand stack, and generic dispatch from that versioned package contract.

case.given: depa-actor exposes stack/frame and dispatch primitives
case.when: The runtime needs those mechanics
case.then: The runtime SHALL reuse the depa-actor primitives instead of duplicating generic stack or dispatcher implementations.

case.given: A caller uses the existing Interpreter API
case.when: The runtime dependency delivery changes
case.then: The existing interpreter path SHALL remain behaviorally unchanged.

requirement.statement: The new interpreter runtime SHALL prioritize porting runtime capabilities from ExtensibleScopedRowType Kon.Interpreter before attempting type-system migration.

case.given: The runtime is created
case.when: Default handlers and keyword expanders are registered
case.then: The runtime SHALL own its handler registry rather than relying only on a static global registry.

case.given: A fiber is created in the new runtime
case.when: The fiber executes instructions
case.then: The fiber SHALL have an instruction stack, operand stack, current environment id, and execution history compatible with the dual-stack VM model.

case.given: A caller evaluates a parsed block or source string
case.when: The new interpreter starts execution
case.then: The runtime SHALL push a land-success instruction and a block/node execution instruction and then dispatch until success, fail, or no runnable fiber remains.

case.given: The ExtensibleScopedRowType runtime has object, property/subscript, host function, environment, and fiber capabilities
case.when: This project ports the runtime
case.then: The first implementation SHALL cover a focused baseline of those runtime capabilities before adding typed runtime behavior.

requirement.statement: The new interpreter runtime SHALL consume the current parser output without changing parser syntax as part of this track.

case.given: The Kon parser profile has been synchronized in the previous parser track
case.when: The new interpreter evaluates Kon source
case.then: The runtime SHALL use the existing parser/converter output as input rather than redefining parser syntax.

case.given: Parser changes previously exposed interpreter test concerns
case.when: The new runtime is implemented
case.then: The test suite SHALL include runtime tests that distinguish parser failures from interpreter execution failures.

requirement.statement: The new runtime SHALL expose extension points needed for future ExtensibleScopedRowType type-system migration without implementing the type checker in this track.

case.given: The future type system needs runtime context and prototype resolution
case.when: The runtime state is designed
case.then: The runtime SHALL reserve a typed runtime context extension point without requiring type checking for ordinary evaluation.

case.given: This track implements the new runtime interpreter
case.when: Type annotations or source-qualified type syntax appear
case.then: The runtime SHALL preserve structures needed by future type-system work but SHALL NOT implement full type binding or checking in this track.

requirement.statement: The project SHALL migrate valuable legacy interpreter test behavior to the new RuntimeInterpreter baseline and remove duplicate old interpreter regressions.

case.given: Legacy interpreter assertions are already covered by RuntimeInterpreter tests
case.when: The test suite is merged into the new runtime baseline
case.then: The project SHALL delete or replace those duplicate legacy assertions

case.given: The legacy Interpreter API remains present
case.when: The old regression suite is reduced
case.then: The project SHALL keep only a minimal compatibility smoke suite for EvalSync, ExecAsync, and state-based execution

case.given: Old tests cover loop and branch behavior
case.when: The behavior is still part of the current language surface
case.then: The project SHALL add RuntimeInterpreter tests using current Kon syntax

case.given: Old tests cover logical and infix macro behavior
case.when: The behavior is still part of the current language surface
case.then: The project SHALL add RuntimeInterpreter tests for short-circuit and mixed logical expression behavior

case.given: A caller reuses one RuntimeInterpreter runtime instance
case.when: The caller evaluates multiple scripts sequentially
case.then: The runtime SHALL preserve expected state across evaluations

case.given: A script needs to interact with a host JavaScript object
case.when: The script invokes the new RuntimeInterpreter host bridge API
case.then: The runtime SHALL provide an equivalent capability to the old js_call and js_apply business behavior

case.given: A script function is exported through the embedding API
case.when: Host JavaScript calls the exported callable
case.then: The callable SHALL bind parameters, execute through RuntimeInterpreter, and return the script result

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL evaluate interpreted string interpolations by executing embedded parser expressions in the current runtime environment and concatenating their string values into the literal result.

case.given: A Kon source string defines a visible variable named name
case.when: RuntimeInterpreter evaluates an interpreted string containing a Kon profile interpolation for that name
case.then: The result SHALL include the current value of name converted to text.

case.given: A Kon interpreted multiline string contains an embedded Kon expression
case.when: RuntimeInterpreter evaluates the string
case.then: The embedded expression SHALL be evaluated in the current runtime and its result SHALL be inserted into the output string.

case.given: A Knl interpreted multiline string contains an embedded Knl expression using square-bracket interpolation syntax
case.when: RuntimeInterpreter evaluates parser output for that string
case.then: The embedded expression SHALL be evaluated with Knl parser semantics and inserted into the output string.

case.given: A raw single-line or raw multiline string contains escape-like or interpolation-like text
case.when: RuntimeInterpreter evaluates the raw string node
case.then: The runtime SHALL return the literal text without escape expansion and without expression evaluation.

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL preserve interpreted string escape semantics for delimiter characters, backslash, newline, tab, and carriage return.

case.given: An interpreted string source escapes double quote characters
case.when: RuntimeInterpreter evaluates the string
case.then: The result SHALL contain literal double quote characters.

case.given: An interpreted string source escapes the backslash before profile-specific interpolation syntax
case.when: RuntimeInterpreter evaluates the string
case.then: The result SHALL contain the interpolation marker text literally rather than evaluating it.

case.given: An interpreted string source contains newline, tab, or carriage-return escapes
case.when: RuntimeInterpreter evaluates the string
case.then: The result SHALL contain the corresponding control characters.

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL support opt-in Kunun dynamic workflow execution through host-registered macro or function extensions that lower to checkpoint-aware effects at safe yield boundaries.

case.given: A Bun coding agent host creates a RuntimeInterpreter runtime
case.when: The host registers workflow extensions named ai_workflow, ai_agent, ai_parallel, ai_pipeline, ai_phase, ai_log, and json_schema
case.then: The runtime SHALL expose those capabilities as host-provided macro or function extensions rather than Kunun language built-ins

case.given: A workflow extension is invoked from Kunun source
case.when: The extension is expanded or lowered
case.then: The runtime SHALL produce checkpoint-aware instruction or effect records instead of an ordinary host function call

case.given: The host registers an infix workflow keyword
case.when: The parser produces an infix knot for that keyword
case.then: The runtime SHALL allow the infix keyword expander to lower the node to checkpoint-aware workflow instructions

case.given: A workflow script invokes an ai_agent extension
case.when: The runtime reaches the ai_agent dispatch boundary
case.then: The runtime SHALL capture a checkpoint containing instruction stack, operand stack, current fiber, environment state, effect handlers, and pending job metadata before yielding to the host runtime

case.given: A captured checkpoint waits for an ai_agent job result
case.when: The host runtime resumes with a completed result
case.then: The runtime SHALL hydrate the checkpoint, inject the result into the continuation, and continue execution from the saved instruction position

case.given: The runtime has multiple fibers
case.when: A workflow checkpoint is captured
case.then: The checkpoint SHALL include all relevant fiber records and identify the current fiber

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL serialize control-flow frames needed to resume loops and exception handling from dynamic workflow safe points.

case.given: A workflow checkpoint is captured inside a foreach or pipeline-like iteration
case.when: The runtime hydrates the checkpoint
case.then: The runtime SHALL restore the iteration cursor, iteration count, loop-local environment, break target, and continue target

case.given: A workflow checkpoint is captured inside a while or for loop
case.when: The runtime resumes
case.then: The next condition, body, break, and continue behavior SHALL match execution without checkpointing

case.given: A checkpoint is captured inside a try body before an ai_agent job completes
case.when: The resumed ai_agent result causes ordinary continuation
case.then: The runtime SHALL continue inside the try body and keep the catch/finally frame active until the try completes

case.given: A checkpoint is captured inside a try body before an ai_agent job completes
case.when: The resumed ai_agent job fails according to host policy
case.then: The runtime SHALL restore the exception frame and enter the matching catch or finally path

case.given: A return, throw, break, or continue is pending while a finally block executes
case.when: The runtime captures and hydrates a checkpoint
case.then: The runtime SHALL preserve the pending abrupt completion state

requirement.statement: The test suite SHALL include a mock AI runtime that verifies Kunun workflow extensions, checkpoint capture, host job dispatch, and resume behavior work together end to end.

case.given: A Kunun workflow invokes a mock ai_agent extension
case.when: The mock AI runtime completes the job and resumes the checkpoint
case.then: The workflow SHALL receive the mock result and complete with the expected final value

case.given: A Kunun workflow starts multiple mock ai_agent jobs through an ai_parallel extension
case.when: Only part of the jobs are completed before checkpoint hydration
case.then: The runtime SHALL preserve completed job results, continue waiting for pending jobs, and return input-order stable results after all jobs complete

case.given: A Kunun workflow executes ai_pipeline stages over multiple items
case.when: A checkpoint is captured during an item stage
case.then: The runtime SHALL resume the correct item and stage without restarting completed stages

case.given: A workflow is resumed from checkpoint
case.when: The test inspects the restored runtime state
case.then: The continuation SHALL be represented by interpreter stacks and frames rather than behavior-tree node-owned state

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL execute language semantics through explicit instruction-stack expansion rather than tree-walk recursive evaluation for compound AST nodes.

case.given: A RuntimeInterpreter fiber receives a parsed AST node through the public execution API
case.when: The runtime handles the node execution instruction
case.then: The handler SHALL expand the node into one or more RuntimeInstruction records on the current fiber instruction stack instead of recursively evaluating the whole node in the handler call.

case.given: A script uses block, function call, branch, loop, try-catch, object, property, subscript, workflow, or effect syntax
case.when: The runtime executes the script
case.then: The runtime SHALL represent the remaining work for the compound form as explicit instructions and operand-stack frames.

case.given: A node is already a literal value or an evaluated runtime value
case.when: The runtime expands the node
case.then: The runtime MAY lower it directly to a value-push instruction without introducing extra evaluator recursion.

case.given: A workflow safe-point is reached inside nested calls, loops, or try-catch blocks
case.when: The runtime captures a checkpoint
case.then: The checkpoint SHALL contain enough instruction stack, operand stack, environment, fiber, and control-frame state to resume without relying on the original JavaScript call stack.

case.given: A checkpoint is captured in the middle of a loop body
case.when: The runtime hydrates and resumes the checkpoint
case.then: The next iteration, break, continue, and loop-local binding behavior SHALL be driven by restored instructions and frames.

case.given: A checkpoint is captured inside a try body or finally body
case.when: The runtime hydrates and resumes the checkpoint
case.then: The active catch, finally, and pending abrupt-completion behavior SHALL be represented by restored instructions and frames.

case.given: A caller uses existing RuntimeInterpreter public entry points
case.when: The execution model is refactored
case.then: The public entry points SHALL remain available and return the same results for existing RuntimeInterpreter tests.

case.given: The parser has already been synchronized with current Kon syntax
case.when: This runtime refactor is implemented
case.then: The parser syntax and parser output contracts SHALL NOT be changed as part of this track.

case.given: The old Interpreter implementation remains in the project
case.when: The RuntimeInterpreter is refactored
case.then: The new RuntimeInterpreter SHALL NOT depend on old Interpreter runtime state or old ExtensionRegistry globals for ordinary execution.

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL migrate confirmed valuable legacy interpreter capabilities before the old interpreter implementation is removed.

case.given: The old interpreter exposes async host, timer, and fiber orchestration semantics
case.when: The project prepares to retire the old interpreter
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL provide equivalent low-level pause/resume and scheduling capabilities independent of workflow checkpoint-only semantics.

case.given: The old interpreter exposes a table object system
case.when: Legacy interpreter capabilities are migrated
case.then: The project SHALL NOT migrate the old table object system as part of this capability-retirement work.

case.given: ExtensibleScopedRowType has a type system that is not yet migrated
case.when: Legacy interpreter capabilities are migrated
case.then: The project SHALL NOT implement or synchronize the type system as part of this track.

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL provide legacy-compatible async host, timer, and fiber scheduling primitives using its instruction-stack and fiber-state model.

case.given: A script invokes a legacy-compatible async host operation
case.when: The host operation has not completed
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL suspend the waiting fiber without blocking unrelated runnable fibers.

case.given: A suspended fiber waits for an async host result
case.when: The host operation resolves or rejects
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL resume the saved continuation with either the result value or the matching failure path.

case.given: A script schedules a timeout operation
case.when: The timer is triggered by the host scheduler or mock scheduler
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL awaken the target fiber and continue from the saved instruction position.

case.given: A script schedules an interval operation
case.when: The interval fires multiple times and is later cleared
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL run each scheduled callback until the interval handle is cleared and SHALL NOT run callbacks after clearing.

case.given: A runtime instruction requests current fiber idle, suspended, or finalized state
case.when: The instruction is dispatched
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL update fiber state deterministically and select the next runnable fiber according to runtime scheduling rules.

case.given: A runtime instruction yields from one fiber to another fiber
case.when: The target fiber is runnable or explicitly awakened
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL switch execution to the target fiber and preserve the yielding fiber continuation.

case.given: Multiple suspended fibers are eligible to resume
case.when: The runtime awakens those fibers
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL transition each target fiber to a runnable state without losing their saved stacks or environments.

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL provide a legacy-compatible reusable embedding callable mode for MakeFuncSync.

case.given: A host creates a callable with RuntimeInterpreter.MakeFuncSync without reusable mode
case.when: The host calls the callable repeatedly
case.then: The callable SHALL preserve existing RuntimeInterpreter default behavior.

case.given: A host creates a callable with reusable mode enabled
case.when: The host calls the callable repeatedly with different arguments
case.then: The callable SHALL reuse the intended runtime/function binding while isolating per-call operand and instruction stack state.

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL migrate confirmed valuable legacy syntax sugar and compatibility aliases without changing current data syntax.

case.given: A script uses legacy prefix forms such as func, do, or main
case.when: The RuntimeInterpreter expands the script
case.then: The runtime SHALL map those forms to current function or block execution semantics.

case.given: A script uses legacy self-update operators such as --, +=, -=, *=, or /=
case.when: The RuntimeInterpreter expands the script
case.then: The runtime SHALL execute the equivalent read-modify-write behavior through instruction-stack expansion.

case.given: A script uses legacy JS interop aliases such as js_call or js_apply
case.when: The RuntimeInterpreter executes the script
case.then: The runtime SHALL route the operation through the current host JavaScript bridge without depending on the old ExtensionRegistry.

case.given: A script uses legacy infix forms def_to, set_to, or save_operands
case.when: The RuntimeInterpreter expands the infix knot
case.then: The runtime SHALL execute equivalent definition, assignment, or operand capture behavior.

case.given: A script uses target chain assignment such as target.:field = value or target.:field := value
case.when: The left side is a writable property or subscript chain expression
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL treat the expression as object assignment compatibility syntax.

case.given: A source file uses equals in map entries, knot metadata, configuration fields, or other data syntax
case.when: The parser and RuntimeInterpreter process the source
case.then: The equals token SHALL retain its data-syntax meaning and SHALL NOT be interpreted as assignment.

case.given: A script uses common legacy host aliases such as Writeln, append, console, clear_interval, &amp;amp;amp;gt;=, or &amp;amp;amp;lt;=
case.when: The RuntimeInterpreter executes the script
case.then: The runtime SHALL provide equivalent behavior or explicit host bridge mappings for those aliases.

requirement.statement: The project SHALL maintain a removal-readiness checklist for old interpreter code after migrated capabilities are covered by RuntimeInterpreter tests.

case.given: A legacy capability is migrated to RuntimeInterpreter
case.when: The old interpreter equivalent test or behavior is identified
case.then: The project SHALL add or update RuntimeInterpreter tests before deleting the legacy behavior coverage.

case.given: The migration test suite passes
case.when: The project prepares to remove old interpreter code
case.then: The project SHALL present remaining old interpreter logic for review before deleting it.

requirement.statement: The runtime package SHALL remove the legacy Interpreter execution pipeline and expose RuntimeInterpreter as the active interpreter surface.

case.given: The package public index is imported
case.when: A consumer inspects exported interpreter APIs
case.then: The package SHALL NOT export Interpreter, XnlState, ExtensionRegistry, or XnlOpCode from the legacy execution pipeline

case.given: The legacy interpreter files have been removed
case.when: RuntimeInterpreter scripts and compatibility tests run
case.then: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL continue to provide the migrated legacy runtime capabilities

requirement.statement: captureSnapshot SHALL 支持 strict 序列化校验选项：开启时若快照含不可 JSON 序列化的值（函数、class 实例、循环引用等），SHALL 抛出指明所在位置（fiber/operand/env key）的明确错误；默认（非 strict）行为保持不变。

case.given: operand 栈含宿主函数值
case.when: 以 strict 模式捕获快照
case.then: SHALL 抛出含位置信息的序列化错误

case.given: 同样的运行时状态
case.when: 以默认模式捕获快照
case.then: 行为 SHALL 与本变更前一致

requirement.statement: runtime 的 workflow extension 机制 SHALL 完全域中立：registerWorkflowExtension 与默认 lowering SHALL NOT 内置任何基于扩展名（如 ai_ 前缀）的特例分支；pending job 的展开方式 SHALL 由注册方显式声明——options.jobExpansion 为 'single'（默认，一个 effect 一个 job）或 'perArg'（按 args 元素逐个展开，path 含 item 序号与 itemIndex metadata），或经 options.buildJobs 回调完全自定义 job 列表；自定义 lowering（registerWorkflowExtension 第二参）行为不变。

case.given: runtime 源码
case.when: 审查 RuntimeState 默认 lowering
case.then: SHALL 不存在按扩展名前缀或特定名字（parallel/pipeline 等）的分支逻辑

case.given: 以 jobExpansion='perArg' 注册的任意名扩展
case.when: WorkflowDispatch 携带 N 个 args
case.then: SHALL 产生 N 个 job，path 含 item:i 且 metadata.itemIndex=i

case.given: 以 buildJobs 回调注册的扩展
case.when: dispatch
case.then: pendingJobs SHALL 完全由回调返回值决定（含 id/path/metadata），经 JSON 序列化往返保持稳定

case.given: 未声明展开方式的扩展
case.when: dispatch
case.then: SHALL 产生单个 job（path 以 /job:0 结尾），args 原样入 job.args

requirement.statement: runtime SHALL 提供通用的 DispatchUntilStop 公共 API：驱动当前指令栈直至 yield（返回 effects 与 stopReason）或指令耗尽，错误与缺失 handler 以异常抛出；上层包（如 workflow-dsl）SHALL 经此 API 驱动执行循环而无需直接依赖 depa-actor。

case.given: 含 WorkflowDispatch 的指令栈
case.when: DispatchUntilStop
case.then: SHALL 返回 yield_requested 与 effect；注入结果后再次调用 SHALL 运行至栈空
